description: Remove networks from every account in the org. Takes effect right away and needs no signature; nothing happens onchain. When the org's accounts hold tokens on a removed network, it is refused unless --confirm-funds-on-removed-networks is passed. Those tokens stay at the same addresses but are inaccessible in Splits until the network is added again with 'accounts add-networks'. Use 'accounts networks' for the networks enabled now. Returns 400 SMART_ACCOUNT_MERKLE_TRANSACTION_IN_PROGRESS while a signer or network change is pending. Requires owner-scoped API key.

confirmFundsOnRemovedNetworks.description: Remove networks even where the org's accounts hold tokens. Confirm with the user first.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounts_remove-networks
